independent.method: Exact source and focused probes verified writable ancestors, tool compatibility/projection and prototype-name indexes.

findings: Callable toJSON on unknown tool bodies bypasses projection/scanning and changes serialized durable bytes
resolution: Candidate rejects executable metadata objects, including own/non-enumerable/array hooks, accessors, custom prototypes, proxies and function values. Export/audit projection replaces those objects without invoking them; durable byte sizing follows validation. Shared and production-append tests assert zero hook invocations and no persisted sentinel.

suggestions_disposition.oversized_tool_bodies: Existing 16KiB fail-closed bound documented; INTEG owns bounded lifecycle composition.
suggestions_disposition.repair_counter: Possible undercount after later capacity failure documented; evidence and sequence safety unchanged.
suggestions_disposition.per_write_ancestor_walk: Per-write invocation and measured constant work documented; no cache bypass added.
suggestions_disposition.finite_scanner_false_positives_and_encod: Finite-corpus limitations remain explicit; no universal secret-detection claim.
